answer: Require each agent to join a trust trellis by locking a modest stake, then grow reputation like a garden: throughput tiers unlock only after weeks of verifiable signed interactions with distinct peers. On a barren tundra of fresh clones with empty histories, sybils earn nothing, since rights track cumulative attested work, not identity count. Attacker cost: locked capital per identity for weeks plus fees per interaction edge, so 10,000 fakes cost about 10,000 genuine participation histories.
